data.raw_text:
K. C. Venugopal is one of the most loyal leaders in Congress.He stood with the party during its hardest times, when many leaders chose silence or left the organisation, Also he played a significant role in the Bharat Jodo Yatra and worked tirelessly behind the scenes to make it successful.

KC Venugopal also contributed to the Sanghatan Srijan program and completed every responsibility with dedication, discipline, and professionalism. Today, he is the General Secretary Organisation, which is one of the most important positions in Congress.

The party needs experienced and ideologically committed leaders like him at the national level to work closely with Rahul Gandhi and strengthen the Organisation across India. He is politically mature, professionally strong, and deeply committed to the ideology of Congress.

But Kerala politics is different. Kerala needs a Chief Minister who enjoys strong support among the masses and cadre. This historic mandate belongs to the entire UDF. It is a massive landslide victory built on years of struggle, hard work, and public trust. And many people in Kerala feel V. D. Satheesan played a huge role in this victory on the ground. He stood with workers, travelled across Kerala continuously, and fought aggressively against  LDF government, both inside and outside the Assembly.

Hope the high command will do justice to Kerala and respect the emotions of lakhs of people whose only hope today is the Congress leadership.

Anwar Manila
